correctness.rationale: The rank-two and rank-three recurrence follows exactly from two-round root splitting. A complete depth-three shattered tree uses at most seven query vertices and eight different witnessing centers, yielding a rigorous 15-vertex induced cutoff in hereditary threshold graphs. All 32767 creation words through order 15 are exhausted by two separate implementations; only the four stated words pass all deletion-minimality tests. Explicit witness trees check all 32 leaf paths. The full theorem follows by induced heredity, not an unproved extrapolation.
